state.title: SAV: Magnolia - Truman Parkway 115kV Rebuild
state.description: Rebuild 3 miles of the Magnolia - Truman Parkway 115kV from 75C 927 ACAR to 200C 1351 ACSS Martin conductor or higher rated conductor. Upgrade 1200A switches at Magnolia substation to 2000A switches and jumpers at Truman Parkway.

q.instructions: What kind of work is this project?

criteria.new_line: Builds a new transmission line on new right-of-way.
criteria.rebuild: Rebuilds, reconductors or upgrades an existing line along its existing corridor.
criteria.substation_construction: Builds a new substation or expands one (new yard, banks, ring bus, fold-ins).
criteria.in_substation_equipment: Replaces or adds equipment inside an existing substation (breakers, relays, transformers, reactors, switch houses) with little field work outside the fence.
